name: Fly.io
tagline: Fly.io is a platform for running full-stack applications and databases close to users at the edge in 30+ regions worldwide. It is particularly popular for deploying AI inference workloads, LLM applications, and latency-sensitive apps. Its simple deployment model (flyctl deploy) appeals to developers who want Heroku simplicity with global scale.
